name: Nirasaki (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nirasaki city emblem in white: a stylised letter S of two diagonal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Nirasaki, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 21 September 1955.

features.role: Nirasaki city emblem — a stylised letter S of two diagonal strokes
